thread:
sabrina: EdgeBoard asked for a perf/W sweep next Tues-Thu. Need kernel tuning lanes, power telemetry access, and announcement blackout window. cc @alex @liv @tom-sales :wave:

alex: Happy to own kernel tuning. Which kernel/driver on their board? We need `CONFIG_HZ` and `CPU_FREQ` governor details. Also need host-side cuda/rocm versions. If they have `pdu` telemetry we'll hook into it.

liv: I'll prep the batch runner and kv-cache disabled run. We should capture per-step energy via /sys/class/powercap or `nvidia-smi` depending on hw. Also collecting perf counters: L2, DRAM BW, SM utilization.

sabrina: Partner says board runs Linux 5.15 + Ampere GPU (AmpereX). They will expose PDUs over IPMI. They asked for non-proprietary metrics only. Also want joint blog after embargo.

alex: OK. I'll prepare two kernel lanes: stock and patched (sched+cpufreq). Patch will be small. Need access to their kernel config and a debug image. @bench-bot can you create a test env? :robot_face:

bench-bot: Created perf env: s3://redwood-bench/edgeboard/1779612345/, runner image tag `rb-bench:2026-03-18`. Provision script: `scripts/provision_edgeboard.sh`.

liv: Test plan uploaded to the same S3 path as `plan.md`. Key metrics: throughput@latency95, energy/J_token, p90-power. CSV schema: run_id, model, batch, seq_len, tokens, latency_ms_p50, latency_ms_p95, watts_avg, joules_total, notes.

tom-sales: Heads-up: marketing wants a 2-week embargo and coordinated marketplace listing on the week after. Please flag PR-ready artifacts. I'll own partner comms.

sabrina: Action items: alex Prepare kernel patch + repro steps by EOD Mon; liv prepare runner+metrics hooks; tom prepare embargo schedule; partner to provide IPMI creds to infra-sec. Ping me when artifacts ready. :thumbsup:

alex: On it. Will post diff and a short runbook in the S3 path.

liv: Will validate power readings on a dry run Wed morning.

bench-bot: Dry run scheduled for 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC. Results placeholder created.

sabrina: Thanks all — let's aim to lock numbers before Friday so marketing can draft the joint announcement. :rocket:
